$why: A FRAGMENT of the detective prompt, 2026-08-16.
The tracker's issue type is a HINT and the prompt says so in both directions. Both texts
exist because the wrong-way error is asymmetric: told it is a defect when it is not, the
agent hunts for a bug that was never there; told it is not when it is, it designs a feature
over a broken behaviour. Two fragments, so neither can be lost by editing the other.
body: \nJIRA DOES NOT CLASSIFY THIS AS A BUG (issue type: __ISSUE_TYPE__). This is a HINT, not a certainty — if the ticket's own text below clearly describes existing behavior that is wrong, trust the ticket over this hint. Assuming novel: there is likely NO existing bug and no wrong value to trace. Inventing a "cause" for a capability that does not exist yet produces a confident wrong answer. Your job is the ATTACHMENT POINT — the existing file/function/provider/hook/route/component this new capability must plug into, and anything already present the implementation should REUSE — not a fix site.\n
description: Told to the detective when the tracker does NOT classify the story as a defect.
